citations.assessment: The Bavli gives both full patronymics and an actual throw. Heilprin supplies the explicit brother characterization.

The Yerushalmi gives a bare Yonatan and the full name Shimon son of Rabbi Yose bar Lakonya; it reports intent to throw. Translate the patronymic explicitly while preserving the separate witness wording.
